artifacts.description: sltwx pack/unpack binary and integration tests

acceptance_criteria: New binary `sltwx` in `swx-io` (`src/bin/sltwx.rs`), with a doc comment describing its usage: `sltwx pack <folder> <file>`: `read_unpacked(folder)`, then `write_sltwx(file)`; `sltwx unpack <file> <folder>`: `read_sltwx(file)`, then `write_unpacked(folder)`, creating `<folder>` (its parent must exist); `sltwx --help` (or `-h`) prints the usage to stdout and exits 0.

Exit codes, never a panic: 0 on success; 2 with the usage on stderr for a missing, extra or unknown argument or subcommand; 1 with a one-line `sltwx: <error>` on stderr for any `FormatError` (its `Display` text) or when the output path already exists (it is never overwritten).

Integration tests using `env!("CARGO_BIN_EXE_sltwx")` and temp paths under `std::env::temp_dir()` with unique names, removed at the end (no new dev-dependencies): pack the golden folder `crates/swx-io/tests/golden/bracket.sltwx/`, unpack the result to a new folder, and every JSON file of the new folder is byte-identical to the golden one; packing the golden folder twice gives byte-identical files; an existing output path gives exit 1 and leaves the file unchanged; `sltwx`, `sltwx pack onlyone` and `sltwx frob a b` give exit 2; unpacking a file containing the text `not a zip` gives exit 1, and stderr names the malformed-archive error from #202; an extension that doesn't match the manifest `kind` (packing to `out.sltwxa`) gives exit 1.
All existing `swx-io` tests pass unchanged; no test is weakened or removed.
No `unsafe`, and `swx-io` still has no workspace dependencies.
`cargo fmt --all --check && cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && cargo test --workspace` pass.
QA report (FACTORY §6b) posted on the PR.
